name: Deepa Venkat
bio: Deepa Venkat (born 11 June 1975) is an Indian actress and dubbing artist. She works as a radio disc jockey at Hello FM Chennai in addition. She has starred in several Tamil films as well as television series.

credits.title: Baththa
credits.overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

credits.title: Ram and Leela
credits.overview: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

credits.title: Vishwanath & Sons
credits.overview: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

credits.title: Kanguva
credits.overview: A bounty hunter in present day, learns about his previous life as a legendary warrior, when fate unites him with a mutant kid.

Sheryl Pinto acts as an ardent fan of MGR and she feels her husband Sundar C should also be like him. Both of them dance for the song Enakku Needhan MGR Unakku Naan Dhan Saroja Devi.

credits.title: Kathai
credits.overview: An award-winning writer meets a famed violinist and they fall in love. They get married and go to New York where they meet her childhood friend, which changes everything.

credits.title: Kanden Kadhalai
credits.overview: After his encounter with a chirpy girl, Anjali, during their train journey, a depressed Sakthivel's attitude towards life changes. Though he is attracted to her, he agrees to help her unite with her lover.

credits.title: Malaikottai
credits.overview: A young man is granted conditional bail, which requires him to go to the Trichy police station. On his way there, he falls for a beautiful girl. When the girl lands up in trouble, he finds himself facing the wrath of powerful politicians.

credits.title: Kudaikul Mazhai
credits.overview: An autorickshaw driver bumps into a beautiful young woman at a coffee shop, who seems to be smitten by him. He does not take her seriously at first, but finds his whole world turned upside down when he falls for her.

credits.title: Ramachandra
credits.overview: Due to his honesty and refusal to meet the demands of those in power, inspector Ramachandran is often transferred from one town to another. Soon, he finds himself in an area that is highly terrorised.

credits.title: Baba
credits.overview: Baba is an atheist who always questions the existence of a higher power. But when a turn of events bestows him with divine powers, he uses the opportunity to help other people.

credits.title: Sreeram
credits.overview: Sreeram's ambition to become a police officer is in jeopardy when he has a fight with Encounter Shankar, a corrupt police officer, when he misbehaves with his girlfriend.

credits.title: Paarthale Paravasam
credits.overview: A doctor becomes an instant heartthrob after making an appearance in a movie and soon marries a woman. But just after their marriage, the truth about his past is revealed, which leads to complications, taking the couple a step closer to divorce.

credits.title: Dhinamdhorum
credits.overview: Dhinamdhorum is a 1998 Tamil language film directed by Nagaraj. The film features Murali, Suvalakshmi, Renuka and Manivannan in the lead roles.

credits.title: Ullasam
credits.overview: Two boys grow up being influenced by each other's respective fathers. While one becomes a singer, the other becomes a local goon. Incidentally, both love the same girl in college.

credits.title: Paasamalargal
credits.overview: In order to earn goodwill, a businessman adopts 6 orphan girls. After the initial friction, he does warm up to them. Meanwhile, a young girl falls in love with him. All goes well till tragedy strikes.
